name: publish to nuget
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - main
jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: NuGet/setup-nuget@v2
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
        with:
          dotnet-version: '10.0.x'

      - name: read common.props
        id: commonProps
        uses: juliangruber/read-file-action@v1
        with:
          path: ./common.props

      - name: get version
        id: getVersion
        uses: AsasInnab/regex-action@v1
        with:
          regex_pattern: '(?<=>)[^<>]+(?=</Version>)'
          regex_flags: 'gim'
          search_string: '${{ steps.commonProps.outputs.content }}'

      - name: dotnet restore
        run: dotnet restore -s "https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json"

      - name: dotnet build
        run: dotnet build -c Release
      
      - name: dotnet test
        run: dotnet test -c Release --no-restore --no-build

      - name: dotnet pack
        run: dotnet pack -c Release --no-build --property PackageOutputPath=${{ github.workspace }}/nugetPackages/

      - name: remove unused packages
        run: |
          cd ${{ github.workspace }}/nugetPackages
          shopt -s extglob
          rm -f !(EasyAbp.*)
          rm -f !(*.${{ steps.getVersion.outputs.first_match }}.nupkg)
          rm -f *.Blazor.Host.*
          rm -f *.Blazor.Server.Host.*
          rm -f *.Host.Shared.*
          rm -f *.HttpApi.Host.*
          rm -f *.IdentityServer.*
          rm -f *.AuthServer.*
          rm -f *.Web.Host.*
          rm -f *.Web.Unified.*
          rm -f *.HttpApi.Client.ConsoleTestApp.*
          rm -f *.Tests.*
          rm -f *.TestBase.*
          ls

      - name: dotnet nuget push to GitHub
        uses: tanaka-takayoshi/nuget-publish-to-github-packages-action@v2.1
        with:
          nupkg-path:  '${{ github.workspace }}/nugetPackages/*.nupkg'
          repo-owner:  'EasyAbp'
          gh-user:  'EasyAbp'
          token:  ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: dotnet nuget push to NuGet
        run: dotnet nuget push ${{ github.workspace }}/nugetPackages/*.nupkg -k ${{secrets.NUGET_API_KEY}} -s https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json --skip-duplicate

      - name: determine if the tag exists
        uses: mukunku/tag-exists-action@v1.0.0
        id: checkTag
        with:
          tag: ${{ steps.getVersion.outputs.first_match }}
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: add git tag
        if: ${{ steps.checkTag.outputs.exists == 'false' }}
        uses: tvdias/github-tagger@v0.0.1
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          tag: ${{ steps.getVersion.outputs.first_match }}

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
